subject.why: Accurately depicts the requested ranch gate with the horseshoe and road.

category.why: Object is grounded on a wide ground plane with an appropriate landscape backdrop.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: Lacks side margins; fence attachments crowd and bleed off the horizontal edges.

colour.why: Bright, warm golden-hour lighting with good contrast against the sky.

detail.why: Clean shapes with no distracting micro-textures or clustered props.

style.why: Consistent chunky 3D volumes and smooth shading matching the references.

fix: Scale the gate down slightly to restore side margins and remove the fence segments bleeding off-screen.
